g.text: In urban Sindh, average earnings climb with age and peak at ages 55-59
Source: PSLM 2019-20 person and household files. Sample: 2,644 earners aged 15-64 in urban Sindh with earnings > 0.
2 earners outside the Rs 10,000-10,000,000 axis are not shown. Grey dots: individual earners (jittered, semi-transparent).
Red markers: weighted mean (hhweight) of each five-year band at its midpoint.
Hollow markers: bands with fewer than 30 unweighted observations.
